items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: And Bobby Miller was giving the credit for that, but Joe Oliver was the first to do it.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, he's about the strongest of all the fellas. Joe Oliver was strong. But you see Joe Oliver, he did a whole lot of playing mutes. Joe Oliver had large hands. And at that time the mute that he was using was just about this long. You see his hand was covered in mute. And he had all kinds of different effects. He used to feature a tune called eccentric. It had a lot of breaks in it. And Bill Johnson, whenever he'd have it, quack, quack, quack, Bill Johnson would say don't cry baby, don't cry baby. And he'd…
But did he really put any of that down on the record where it sounds like he did? I never heard him recall that.
